entries.name: Abbie Hoffman

expected.charges: Conspiracy and crossing state lines with intent to incite a riot (Anti-Riot Act of 1968); contempt of court (during trial)
expected.sentence:
Initial booking custody after March 1969 arrest before bail was posted; cited for approximately 8 months of contempt by Judge Hoffman during trial (also reversed on appeal); sentenced to 5 years and a $5,000 fine on the riot-act count but released on bail pending appeal and never served the underlying sentence after convictions were reversed

Verdict as recorded: Convicted by jury (where applicable) of crossing state lines to incite a riot; all riot-act convictions reversed by the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Seventh Circuit in November 1972 and all contempt convictions reversed in May 1972

updates.sentence: Physical custody from February 14 to February 28, 1970 following contempt commitment, ending with release on bail. Sentenced February 20 to five years and a $5,000 fine on the Anti-Riot Act count; that conviction was later reversed. The appeal period was not continuous imprisonment.

entries.rationale: Replace false March 1969-November 1972 continuous imprisonment with individually established February 1970 custody. Court footnote23 confirms Dellinger Feb4 and Hoffman Feb14/Rubin Feb15; contemporary Feb15 dispatch identifies Davis/Hayden/Hoffman Feb14 and Rubin/Froines/Weiner Feb15 commitments. All seven physically released Feb28. Earlier booking dates remain unresolved; March19 arrest field retained pending individual verification, not counted as start of this custody episode. Inclusive court totals for Hoffman/Rubin differ by one from website elapsed-day convention.
